name: claude-code-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: function-hook plugins that run inside the session

plugins.name: english-coach
plugins.description: Checks the grammar and fluency of each prompt you type, in parallel, and shows corrections and a word or expression to learn above the prompt

plugins.name: toolbar
plugins.description: A Toolbar button under the prompt: pick the model and effort, open the project in VS Code, and switch clean view, which hides the work and shows a step tracker of the task list
